about_zh: 数据库、分析、可视化与采集管道。

repos.description: 🕷️ The BEST Web Scraping framework that handles everything from a single request to a full-scale crawl! Don't be shy, join here: https://discord.gg/EMgGbDceNQ and follow here for daily tips and tricks: https://x.com/Scrapling_dev
repos.summary_zh: Scrapling 是一个自适应网页抓取框架，能够处理从单请求到大规模爬取的全场景需求。其核心亮点在于智能解析器可学习网站变化并自动重定位元素，内置绕过 Cloudflare 等反爬系统的能力，支持并发多会话爬取、自动代理轮换和暂停恢复功能。提供实时统计、CLI 和 MCP 服务器集成，是现代 Web 数据采集的高效解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Scrapling is an adaptive web scraping framework designed to handle everything from simple single requests to complex large-scale crawling operations. Its standout feature is an intelligent parser that learns from website changes and automatically relocates elements when pages update. The framework includes built-in anti-bot bypass capabilities that defeat systems like Cloudflare Turnstile out of the box. It enables concurrent multi-session crawling with automatic proxy rotation, pause/resume functionality, and real-time streaming statistics. With integrated CLI tools and an MCP server, Scrapling offers a powerful yet straightforward solution for modern web data extraction at any scale.

repos.description: Official Crawl4AI Cloud: a hosted web scraping, extraction, and search API for AI agents. Free API key, 1,000 credits a month, no card. Fully open source: this repo is the Apache-2.0 crawler that powers it, and you can self-host it.
repos.summary_zh: Crawl4AI 是一款开源的LLM友好型网页爬虫，专为RAG、AI代理和数据管道设计。它将网页转换为干净的Markdown格式，便于大语言模型处理。项目亮点包括：崩溃恢复机制支持长时间深度爬取；预取模式提升5-10倍URL发现速度；提供自托管平台，含企业级监控仪表板和REST API；采用浏览器池管理技术。拥有5万+星标社区验证，相比现有方案显著降低成本，支持完全本地化部署。
repos.summary_en: Crawl4AI is an open-source, LLM-friendly web crawler designed for RAG, AI agents, and data pipelines. It converts web content into clean Markdown format optimized for language models. Key features include crash recovery for long-running deep crawls, prefetch mode for 5-10x faster URL discovery, and a self-hosting platform with enterprise-grade monitoring dashboard, REST API, and WebSocket streaming. Battle-tested by a 50k+ star community, it offers a cost-effective alternative to paid solutions with full local deployment capabilities and smart browser pool management.

repos.description: Elegant reading of real-time and hottest news
repos.summary_zh: NewsNow 是一款优雅的实时热门新闻阅读器，聚合多源热点资讯，采用自适应抓取与缓存机制优化资源并防封禁，支持 GitHub 登录同步与 MCP 服务，提供极简 UI，易于部署于 Cloudflare、Vercel 或 Docker。
repos.summary_en: NewsNow is an elegant real-time trending news reader that aggregates multi-source hot topics with adaptive scraping and caching to optimize resources and avoid bans. It supports GitHub OAuth sync, MCP server, clean UI, and easy deployment on Cloudflare, Vercel, or Docker.

repos.description: Open-source intelligence for the global theater. Track everything from the corporate/private jets of the wealthy, and spy satellites, to seismic events in one unified interface. Hook an AI agent up to have it parse through data and find previously unseen correlations. The knowledge is available to all but rarely aggregated in the open, until now.
repos.summary_zh: ShadowBroker是实时多域开源情报平台，聚合60+公开数据源包括航班ADS-B、船舶AIS、卫星遥测及地震信息。基于Next.js与MapLibre GL构建交互式地图，支持35+数据层切换与右键地理情报查询。采用自托管架构确保隐私，面向分析师提供全球威胁监控与研究工作。
repos.summary_en: ShadowBroker is a real-time OSINT platform aggregating 60+ public data sources including aircraft ADS-B, maritime AIS, satellite telemetry and seismic events. Built with Next.js and MapLibre GL, it provides 35+ interactive data layers and geospatial analysis tools. Self-hosted deployment ensures privacy for analysts tracking global threats and conducting open-source intelligence research.

repos.description: 🔥 基于大模型和 RAG 的智能问数系统，对话式数据分析神器。Text-to-SQL Generation via LLMs using RAG.
repos.summary_zh: SQLBot 是基于大语言模型与 RAG 的智能问数系统，实现自然语言到 SQL 的精准转换。支持对话式数据分析（ChatBI），提供开箱即用的部署体验，内置工作空间隔离与细粒度权限管控。通过术语库与示例校准持续优化，支持 Web 嵌入、MCP 调用等多种集成方式，快速赋能业务系统智能查询能力。
repos.summary_en: SQLBot is an LLM-powered intelligent data query system leveraging RAG for accurate Text-to-SQL conversion. It enables conversational data analysis (ChatBI) with out-of-the-box deployment, featuring workspace isolation and fine-grained access control. The system continuously improves through custom terminology and SQL examples, offering flexible integration via Web embedding and MCP calls to rapidly empower business applications with natural language query capabilities.

repos.summary_zh: 这是一个基于大语言模型的知识图谱自动生成系统。它将非结构化文本解析为'主-谓-宾'三元组，通过实体标准化和关系推理构建结构化知识网络，并生成交互式可视化。系统支持任何OpenAI兼容的LLM API（如Ollama、vLLM），提供文本分块、实体消歧、关系推断等完整流水线，适用于文档知识挖掘、研究资料整理等场景。核心价值在于将海量文本转化为可探索的语义网络，实现知识的直观呈现与深度关联分析。
repos.summary_en: This is an automated knowledge graph generation system powered by Large Language Models. It processes unstructured text by extracting Subject-Predicate-Object triplets via LLMs, then constructs structured knowledge networks through entity standardization and relationship inference. The system produces interactive visualizations and supports any OpenAI-compatible API endpoints (Ollama, vLLM, cloud services). Key features include text chunking, entity resolution, transitive inference, and configurable pipelines. It transforms textual information into explorable semantic networks, enabling deep knowledge discovery and visual analytics for research and document analysis.

repos.description: Identify email addresses or domains names that belong to colleges or universities. Help automate the process of approving or rejecting academic discounts.
repos.summary_zh: JetBrains/swot 仓库维护全球教育机构邮箱域名列表，用于自动验证学生和教师身份并授予 JetBrains 工具免费许可证。核心价值是简化学术折扣审批流程，支持全球高校用户获取专业开发工具。应用场景覆盖学生免费授权与教育机构验证。技术亮点包括层级目录结构存储域名、子域名自动包含、滥用域名黑名单及严格准入规则，确保数据准确可靠。
repos.summary_en: JetBrains/swot maintains a hierarchical list of academic email domains to verify eligibility and grant free JetBrains tool licenses to students and teachers worldwide. Core value lies in automating academic discount approvals for global educational users. Application scenarios include student/teacher license verification. Technical highlights feature structured directory storage, subdomain inclusion, abused domain blacklist, and strict inclusion criteria for authenticity.

repos.summary_zh: 为独立游戏开发者提供AI动画转精灵图的生产级管线。通过FFmpeg帧提取、自动去背景、智能打包成256x256标准格式，内置浏览器审查工具与AI助手集成，实现从AI生成视频到游戏可用资源的可控生产流程，确保仅审核通过的资产进入项目。
repos.summary_en: Provides indie game developers with a production-grade pipeline for converting AI-generated animations into sprite sheets. It extracts frames via FFmpeg, performs automatic matting, packs assets into standardized 256x256 formats, and includes a browser-based review tool with AI assistant integration, ensuring only approved outputs are promoted to game projects.

repos.summary_zh: Austen是一款AI驱动的文学分析工具，通过集成DeepSeek/OpenAI自动解析书籍角色关系，并生成Mermaid可视化图谱。基于Next.js全栈框架与Supabase后端，支持用户管理、图表保存(SVG/PNG)与社交分享，为教育、阅读及文学研究提供直观的关系探索体验。
repos.summary_en: Austen is an AI-powered literary analysis tool that automatically extracts character relationships from books using DeepSeek/OpenAI and visualizes them via Mermaid diagrams. Built on Next.js fullstack with Supabase backend, it enables user management, graph export (SVG/PNG), and social sharing—ideal for educators, readers, and literary research to visually explore narrative dynamics.

repos.description: ⚡ StreamGet -  A Multi-Platform Live Stream Parser Library for Python
repos.summary_zh: StreamGet 是一个轻量级 Python 直播流解析库，支持 40+ 主流平台（抖音、TikTok、B站、小红书等）的 HLS/FLV 协议。采用异步架构提供统一 API，无需为各平台单独开发解析逻辑，可快速构建直播监控、数据采集、内容分析与自动录播应用，显著降低开发门槛。
repos.summary_en: StreamGet is a lightweight Python library for real-time live stream acquisition, supporting HLS/FLV protocols across 40+ platforms including Douyin, TikTok, Bilibili, and Xiaohongshu. It provides a unified async API that eliminates platform-specific parsing logic, enabling rapid development of live stream monitoring, data collection, content analysis, and automated recording applications while significantly reducing development complexity.

repos.description: The genuine open dictionary, grounded by Wikitionary and explained more with LLMs
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Wiktionary 构建的开源多语言词典，通过 LLM 增强解释质量。核心亮点是处理 10M+ 词条的流式流水线架构，支持自动分区、数据清洗及 50 并发 LLM 调用生成结构化学习内容，TOON 格式优化 token 使用达 30-60%。适用于语言学习应用、词典服务和 NLP 数据增强。
repos.summary_en: An open multilingual dictionary rebuilding from Wiktionary with LLM-enhanced definitions. Its architecture processes 10M+ entries via streaming pipeline, featuring automated partitioning, data cleaning, and 50-concurrent LLM calls for generating learner-friendly structured content. Optimized with TOON format reducing token usage by 30-60%. Ideal for language learning apps and NLP data augmentation.
